Author: T3chnicalD3ath Inc.
Name: Reaction Helper
Description: Load a fight timeline (cactbot format) or a per-job profile, and attach reactions to mechanics: conditions on you, your target and your party, and actions that press a skill, flip a MachinistHelper or BeastMasterHelper toggle, hold an action, or show an alert.
Punchline: Timeline and job reactions that drive your rotation plugins.
